editorial:
Imagine waking up to find every single criminal in Arkham Asylum is suddenly loose in your city. That is exactly the nightmare you get into here. You follow Bruce Wayne as he tries to play a giant game of whack-a-mole with his worst enemies while Gotham falls apart around him. The vibe is stressful and gritty, making you feel how tired Batman actually is. It is not just about punching bad guys; it is about a man who is running on empty and refuses to quit, even when the odds are totally against him.

The action scenes are the best part, especially when the fights get heavy and hit hard. The pacing stays quick, though some of the middle parts feel a bit repetitive. If you love superhero stories that focus on the struggle rather than just the powers, you will love this. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail in the animation. If you are a big fan of the comics, grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection is a smart move so you can rewatch the big fights anytime.
endingExplained: Everything leads up to the big fight where Bane finally breaks Batman's back. You see Bruce give it his all, but Bane is just too strong and smart. The movie ends on a huge cliffhanger with Batman defeated and unable to walk. It leaves you wondering who will protect Gotham now that its hero is broken. It is a shocking twist that sets up the second part of the story perfectly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves DC comics and high-stakes action movies.
